name: Titu Cusi
contribution: An Inca ruler of Vilcabamba and the penultimate leader of the Neo-Inca State.

checks.lead: Titu Cusi (Spanish: Diego de Castro Titu Kusi Yupanqui; Spanish pronunciation: [ˈdjeɣo ðe ˈkastɾo ˈtitu ˈkusi ʝuˈpaŋki]; Quechua: Titu Kusi Yupanki [ˈtɪtʊ ˈkʊsɪ jʊˈpæŋkɪ]) (1529 – 1571) was an Inca ruler of Vilcabamba and the penultimate leader of the Neo-Inca State. He was a son of Manco Inca Yupanqui. He was crowned in 1563, after the death of his half brother, Sayri Túpac. He ruled until his death in 1571, probably of pneumonia.
